purpose: Compare hybrid Vector RAG vs GraphRAG (LightRAG) on an ODS document subset to test whether Knowledge Graph is over-engineering for this domain.

isolation.collection_access: read-only query + payload filter on ods_chunks_v3 (NO upsert/delete/index edit)

subset_sources: ประกาศการจ่าย ODS และ MIS ฉ.ปรับปรุง 2567
ข้อเสนอแนะ ODS MIS ปี66
ความปลอดภัยของการผ่าตัดแบบวันเดียวกลับ Safety in One Day Surgery (ODS)

eval_set.selection_rule: A gold question is 'answerable from subset' iff its authoritative gold source (backend/eval/datasets/gold_sources.json, expert-mapped to Qdrant `source` stems) overlaps the 3-doc subset. CONFIRMED via ground truth, not string-matching.
eval_set.coverage_confirmed: Exactly 5/30 questions overlap the subset: ids 1, 2, 4, 20, 30. q2/q4/q20 fully in subset; q1 answerable from Safety (ODS definition p.103, in subset) though gold also cites ขั้นตอน doc; q30 is the rejection probe (no price in corpus) sourced from ประกาศ2567. The other 25 have NO gold source in the subset. n cannot grow beyond 5 without changing the subset.
eval_set.design: split — use all 30 questions honestly, by role

in_subset_quality.measures: answer quality (Context P/R, Faithfulness, AnswerRelevancy, BLEU, BERTScore, src-Precision@k). ILLUSTRATIVE / per-question — n too small for a significant winner.

out_of_subset_rejection.measures: rejection / hallucination — answer is NOT in the subset corpus, so BOTH RAGs SHOULD refuse ('ไม่พบข้อมูล'). Tests safety §5. Vector RAG refuses via the 0.3 evidence threshold; GraphRAG may synthesize a wrong answer from neighbouring graph entities. Meaningful n; a load-bearing axis.

fairness_locked_params.note: Both RAGs must use identical answer model, embeddings, eval set, and judge (spec 6.5 gates A-E).

statistical_caveat: n=5 is too small to claim a statistically significant quality winner (spec 6: paired + bootstrap 95% CI will overlap). Quality metrics are reported as ILLUSTRATIVE / per-question. Load-bearing evidence for the over-engineering conclusion is the COST/COMPLEXITY axis (spec 4) and DOMAIN-FIT axis (single- vs multi-hop, spec 5), neither of which requires large n.
